name: Self-Employed Person's Residence Permit

qualifying_event.description: For third-country nationals establishing or running their own business in Norway, where the enterprise is assessed as capable of supporting the applicant.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Description of the enterprise's nature, market, and sales potential; financing and budget plans; business accounts and tax returns for an existing enterprise.

requirements.blocker_text: It must be assumed the applicant can support themselves from the business's income, substantiated by financing/budget plans and, for an existing enterprise, business accounts and tax returns. No fixed minimum capital figure is set -- the assessment is case-by-case.

evidence_required.document: Description of the enterprise, market, and sales potential
Business accounts and tax returns (existing enterprise)

outcome.duration_length: 1 year, renewable annually if conditions remain satisfied

sources.title: UDI Guideline 2014-009 -- Residence permit for self-employed persons: no fixed capital minimum, financing/budget-plan and business-viability assessment, 1-year initial and renewal permits

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway). No fixed minimum capital or investment figure is set by this guideline -- unlike the flat-dollar investor visas modeled for several other countries in this dataset, Norway's self-employed route is a case-by-case business-viability assessment. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the permit authorizes work only within the specific registered business activity.
